The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has made it mandatory for all Tier-1 retailers to integrate their POS systems with the FBR IRIS portal.

Introduction to FBR POS Systems

The FBR has introduced the Sales Tax Act, which requires all retailers to use a POS system that is integrated with the FBR IRIS portal. This is to ensure that all sales are reported accurately and that the correct amount of sales tax is paid.

To comply with the FBR regulations, retailers in Quetta need to use a POS system that is compatible with the FBR IRIS portal. Top 3 FBR POS Integration Cost Factors is a crucial step in ensuring that your business is compliant with the FBR regulations.

Core Explanation of FBR IRIS Portal

The FBR IRIS portal is an online platform that allows retailers to report their sales and pay their sales tax. The portal uses an API to integrate with POS systems, allowing retailers to automatically report their sales and pay their sales tax.

The FBR IRIS portal uses a token-based system to authenticate users. The token is valid for a certain period, after which it expires and needs to be renewed. Deeper Insight into FBR IRIS Portal

The FBR IRIS portal uses a complex algorithm to calculate the sales tax payable by retailers. The algorithm takes into account the type of goods sold, the quantity sold, and the price of the goods. Retailers need to ensure that their POS system is configured correctly to report the correct sales tax payable.
